metadata.boundary: Invokes the pinned released MACU scheduler, prompts, CUA subprocesses, VM variants, final selection, and result ingestion for a generic no-initial-setup task; full identity additionally requires pinned dependencies, VM image, and models.
metadata.benchmark_boundary: This is not an OSWorld benchmark run: the adapter does not supply a domain/UUID task map, enter canonical task setup, or invoke the OSWorld evaluator.
